title: High energy density lithium battery systems: from key cathode materials to pouch cell design
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00641D, Review Article
Chengrong Xu, Bo Peng, Wujie Yang, Jiaming Tian, Haoshen Zhou
This work focuses on high energy lithium batteries from key cathodes to pouch cells. Characteristics, challenges, and progress of five promising cathodes are summarized. It also explores the impact of each component in pouch cells on energy density.
